result:
Good, these are the standard Next.js/TS scaffolding files (normal to keep). The repo is now clean, builds successfully, and type-checks cleanly.

## Summary

The core finding: this wasn't really a "write more content" problem — **the entire live site is still the pre-pivot product**. GSC shows real demand for InboxZap (an email-cleanup tool) — branded queries already rank well (~pos 4), but every informational query that matters (`gmail storage full` – 790 impr, `unsubscribe from newsletters` – 560, `how to reach inbox zero` – 1,180, etc.) sits at position 40-65 despite genuinely decent blog content existing for most of them. Meanwhile the homepage, features, pricing, and every blog post's chrome were still 100% "Lumina," an unrelated AI meeting-notes product — so Google has no consistent topical signal that this site is about email cleanup at all.

Fixes applied in the repo:
- **Finished the rebrand**: homepage, nav, footer, and JSON-LD rewritten from Lumina → InboxZap consistently (previously only `<title>`/meta had been updated, body content hadn't).
- **Built the missing pages**: `/features`, `/pricing`, `/faq` didn't exist in the repo at all (nav linked to 404s). Added all three, each targeting specific query clusters from GSC and cross-linking into the blog.
- **Fixed blog architecture**: the blog index fetched from a non-existent `/api/posts` client-side (zero content in initial HTML). Rebuilt as server-rendered pages (`app/blog/posts.ts` + `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`), added `Article`/`FAQPage`/`Organization`/`SoftwareApplication` structured data, and per-post metadata.
- **Fixed keyword cannibalization**: `post-3` and `post-7` both targeted "bulk delete emails" and were splitting that query's ranking signal. Merged into one authoritative post and 301-redirected `post-7` → `post-3` to consolidate link equity.
- **Fixed indexing gaps**: `sitemap.ts` had a `TODO` leaving out every blog post; now includes all pages and posts with `lastModified` dates.
- **Content quality**: expanded all 11 posts with proper H2 structure, removed stale "2024" references, added internal cross-links between related posts and into `/features`/`/pricing`, and added a product tie-in CTA per post (previously zero internal linking existed between posts).

Verified with `npm run build` (clean, 20/20 static pages) and a local production smoke test of all routes including the redirect.

One thing I didn't touch: the `og:image` paths reference `/img/og-inboxzap.png`, which doesn't exist as an actual file — I didn't fabricate a binary image. Also worth flagging separately: `next@14.2.5` has a known security advisory; upgrading is outside this task's scope but worth doing soon.
